articles.image_title: Podcast »Unsere verrückten Heiligen«: Archbishop Oscar Romero (1917 - 1980) at home in San Salvador, 20th November 1979. Known locally as Monsenor Romero, Archbishop Romero was assassinated by a gunman whilst celebrating mass on 24th March 1980. His death provoked an international outcry for human rights reform in El Salvador.
